comments.text: Many people say thatLaos is a landlocked country but I think differently, Laos does not have a border with the sea, but Laos has access to the sea through 03 countries: through Vietnam, through Cambodia, and through Thailand.

replies.text: Fair nuance - "landlocked" refers to having no direct coastline, but you're right that river and transit agreements through neighboring countries do give Laos practical access to seaports, even without a border on the sea itself.

comments.author: @wamengmoua7526
comments.text: Why Laos country and most bombed countries in the world..??? 😢

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: It comes down to the Vietnam War era - the US ran a covert bombing campaign against North Vietnamese supply routes running through Laos (the Ho Chi Minh Trail) for nearly a decade, making it the most heavily bombed country per capita in history.
